The eight highest-consequence entitlement, prerequisite, pairing, pricing and release-stage claims above were verified; no factual correction was supported.

validationOutcomes.detail: All three synchronization check gates passed and node --test tests/*.test.cjs passed 79 of 79 tests.

validationOutcomes.check: Canonical, legacy, themed and invalid routes
validationOutcomes.detail: The canonical and legacy-preview routes loaded the same 20 capabilities and five evidence questions; the Cisco theme preserved route state, and malformed provider/region values remained unverified selections.
Keyboard activation of the skip link preserved theme state and moved to the comparison target. Keyboard activation opened source context and pointer activation closed it.
The available cloud-browser surface did not expose viewport resizing; structural responsive tests were not treated as rendered narrow-screen proof.
No native print-to-PDF artifact or page-by-page pagination surface was available; structural print tests remain separate.
The snapshot action did not expose a browser download event within ten seconds, so no downloaded file or independent reopen was claimed.
The ES Editions view intentionally registers no additional WebMCP tools. Existing Release Guide tools were checked separately by Release Watch.
Publication and post-deployment verification occur after this audit artifact is finalized and are reported separately; this field is not pre-marked passed.
